gates.title: Scope and governance
gates.acceptance: Founding frozen scope and human final authority recorded; no accidental publication or authority grant

gates.title: Infrastructure and deployment
gates.acceptance: Fresh production HTTP+DNS+Cloudflare configuration, source SHA, rollback and credentials custody independently checked

gates.title: Model-backed CIT
gates.acceptance: Live staging or reviewed deployment invokes real model, source anchored to approved AGI-0001 record, preserves request/return and refusals

gates.title: Publication and learning
gates.acceptance: AGI canonical human+machine manifests; GFC excluded; three missions properly labeled; Mission 03 reproducible

gates.title: Participation and circulation
gates.acceptance: External GitHub write path honestly labeled; independent context-zero and evidence/review seam; Office receipt not overclaimed

gates.title: Security and privacy
gates.acceptance: Prompt injection/secret isolation/data retention/rate limits/rollback validated on real deployment footprint

gates.title: Final public beta authorization
gates.acceptance: Human explicit GO only after all blocking gates PASS and evidence preserved; otherwise HOLD or separately approved reduced static release
